prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: portrait background plate for My Bar App Store marketing screenshots.
Primary request: a polished cosmic neon background inspired by the app's existing purple, magenta and cyan galaxy visual identity. Background only, ready for real app screenshots and localized captions to be composited later.
Scene/backdrop: deep midnight purple starfield, luminous violet and magenta nebula clouds along the side edges, selective cyan glints, subtle lower magenta glow and a faint reflective haze at the bottom.
Style/medium: premium digital space illustration, refined cinematic texture, elegant rather than noisy.
Composition/framing: tall portrait approximately 9:19.5. A dark quiet central area occupies most of the canvas for a phone screenshot. Keep the top 15 percent and bottom 12 percent dark and calm for readable captions; the brightest nebula detail stays near the outer side edges. Balanced framing that also tolerates center crops for tablet and foldable aspect ratios.
Color palette: midnight navy, rich violet, pink-magenta, restrained electric cyan.
Constraints: background artwork only. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, phones, tablets, device frames, interfaces, icons, people, cocktail glasses, bottles, or other objects. No bright central starburst. Opaque background.
role: Background plate only. Real UI, localized captions and a generic decorative frame are composited by compose_marketing.dart.
transformations: Uniform cover scaling and center crop for each canvas; dark readability overlay. No generated UI or generated lettering.
reference: User-supplied docs/screenshots/1en-m.png was visual style inspiration, not edited or reused.
